title: Password pattern 'Pass123!' causes login form submit to fail silently
expected: Login should succeed or return an authentication error message.
actual: Form submit listener exits silently without calling the API or displaying an error.

title: Search clear button resets text box but does not update product grid
steps: Type a search query in the header search bar (e.g. 'Laptop')
Click the 'X' clear button inside the search input
expected: Search box clears and product grid re-fetches to display all products.
actual: Search text box clears but product grid remains filtered to previous query.

title: Product sorting 'Price: Low to High' sorts in descending order when category filter is active
steps: Select sort option 'Price: Low to High'
expected: Products should be sorted from lowest price to highest price.
actual: Products are sorted in descending order (highest price first).

title: Pagination skips product #10 when transitioning to Page 2
steps: Click 'Next' button to navigate to Page 2
expected: Page 2 should display item #9 through item #16 sequentially.
actual: Product #10 is skipped due to off-by-one pagination skip calculation on backend.

title: Quick View 'Add to Cart' updates cart state but fails to update header badge count
steps: Click the eye icon on any product card to open Quick View modal
Click 'Add to Cart' button inside modal
expected: Product is added to cart and header cart badge counter increments by 1.
actual: Product is added to cart but header badge counter remains unchanged until page reload.

title: Rapidly clicking quantity '+' drops increment pulses due to stale closure state
steps: Rapidly click '+' quantity button 5 times in less than 1 second
expected: Cart quantity increments by 5.
actual: Cart quantity increments by only 1 or 2 due to un-callback state updates.

title: Remove-from-cart hides row visually but fails to call backend DELETE endpoint
steps: Add an item to shopping cart
Navigate to /cart and click the Trash icon to remove item
expected: Item is permanently deleted from cart database.
actual: Item vanishes from UI initially, but reappears upon browser page refresh.

title: Broken image URL for seeded product #8 (Wireless Earbuds)
steps: Navigate to /products or filter by Electronics
expected: Product displays valid product image.
actual: Image source contains invalid file extension '.pngg', displaying placeholder fallback.

title: Mobile navigation menu sheet does not close upon link selection
steps: Tap any link in the mobile drawer (e.g. 'All Products')
expected: Mobile navigation drawer closes automatically after navigation.
actual: Page navigates but mobile navigation drawer stays open overlaying content.

title: Back button from checkout returns to /profile instead of /products
steps: Click 'Back to Shopping' button at top of page
expected: Navigates back to product catalog /products.
actual: Navigates incorrectly to user profile page /profile.

title: Registration accepts invalid email format ending in .com without @ symbol
expected: Form throws validation error 'Invalid email format'.
actual: Registration succeeds because backend regex allows '.com' without '@'.

title: Username registration accepts leading and trailing whitespace without trimming
expected: Name should be trimmed to 'John Doe'.
actual: Spaces are preserved in database as '   John Doe   '.

title: Password validation enforces strictly > 6 length, rejecting valid 6-character passwords
expected: Registration accepts 6-character password.
actual: Fails with error 'Password must be longer than 6 characters'.

title: Cart quantity input allows entering '0' manually via keyboard
steps: Manually type '0' in the quantity input field
expected: Input rejects 0 or prompts user to confirm item removal.
actual: Quantity accepts 0, resulting in 0 quantity row with 0 subtotal.

title: Backend POST /api/cart accepts negative quantity payload
expected: API returns 400 Bad Request error.
actual: Saves negative quantity -2 in database and subtracts amount from total.

title: Checkout shipping address accepts string containing only whitespace
steps: Clear address field and type '   ' (3 spaces)
expected: Validation error 'Shipping address is required'.
actual: Address passes frontend validation and order is placed with blank address.

title: Coupon code input fails for lowercase input 'welcome10'
expected: Coupon is normalized to uppercase WELCOME10 and applied.
actual: Returns error 'Invalid or inactive coupon code'.

title: Search query with special characters '%' or '?' triggers HTTP 500 error
expected: Search handles special characters safely or returns no results.
actual: Backend throws URIError resulting in HTTP 500 server error.

title: Min Price filter accepts non-numeric string 'abc' returning empty product list
steps: Type 'abc' in Min Price input field
expected: Validation error or ignored non-numeric input.
actual: Sends NaN to query, returning empty product list with no error message.

title: Checkout phone number accepts non-numeric characters e.g. '+1-800-CALL-ME'
expected: Phone number field validates numeric format.
actual: Order completes accepting letters in phone number.

title: Cart quantity limit max 10 fails when quantity is set to exactly 10
expected: Quantity 10 is accepted (since limit is 1-10).
actual: Fails with error 'Quantity must be strictly less than 10 items'.

title: Coupon WELCOME10 fails on exact ₹1,000 cart subtotal
steps: Add items totaling exactly ₹1,000 to cart
expected: 10% discount is applied to cart.
actual: Returns error 'Cart total must be greater than ₹1,000'.

title: Free shipping condition charges ₹99 shipping fee on exact ₹2,000 total
steps: Add items totaling exactly ₹2,000 to cart
expected: Shipping fee should be FREE (₹0).
actual: Shipping fee of ₹99 is charged because condition checks subtotal > 2000.

title: Coupon expiration checks strictly < midnight timestamp declaring coupon expired on expiry day
steps: Apply coupon EXPIRED50 on its exact expiry date
expected: Coupon should be valid until end of expiry date.
actual: Declared expired at 00:00:00 on expiry day.

title: Product review rating accepts 0 and 6 stars
steps: Navigate to any product detail page
Type '0' or '6' in review rating box and submit
expected: Rating input accepts only 1 to 5 stars.
actual: Review is saved with 0 or 6 stars.

title: Admin Add Product name limit allows 2 and 51 characters
expected: Fails validation (min 3 characters).
actual: Product is created with 2-character name.

title: Category discount calculation applies discount to unit price once excluding quantity
steps: Add 3 units of Electronics item with 10% discount
Check item row subtotal in cart
expected: 10% discount applied to total item price (3 * price * 0.9).
actual: Discount applied once to single unit price.

title: Cart API subtotal calculation skips items with exactly 0% discount
steps: Add item with 0% discount (e.g. Ergonomic Optical Mouse ₹1,299) to cart
expected: Subtotal includes ₹1,299.
actual: Subtotal is ₹0 because calculation loop skips items where discount == 0.

title: Tax is calculated on original subtotal BEFORE applying coupon discount
steps: Apply coupon SUPER20 (20% off = ₹400 off, discounted subtotal = ₹1,600)
actual: Tax = 18% of ₹2,000 = ₹360.00 (calculated before discount).

title: Checkout adds ₹99 express shipping fee even when eligible for free shipping
steps: Place order over ₹2,000 and select Express Shipping option
expected: Free shipping covers standard order; express fee added clearly.
actual: Shipping fee stacks inappropriately.

title: Coupon code sent as comma-separated string applies double discount
expected: Coupon applied once (10% off).
actual: Discount doubled to 20% off.

title: Fixed discount coupon SAVE100 causes order total to become negative on cart total < 100
steps: Add single item worth ₹50 to cart
expected: Total capped at ₹0.
actual: Order total becomes negative (-₹50).

title: Out of stock products (stock: 0) still render enabled 'Add to Cart' button on Search page
steps: Search for 'Athletic Jogger Sweatpants' (out of stock product)
expected: Button should be disabled with 'Out of Stock' label.
actual: Button is enabled and allows adding out-of-stock product to cart.

title: User can add quantity exceeding available product stock
steps: Find product with 4 units of stock
Add 50 units to cart via API
expected: API rejects request 'Quantity exceeds available stock'.
actual: 50 units added to cart successfully.

title: Changing item quantity in cart updates row subtotal but does not recalculate cart grand total
expected: Row total and Grand Total both update immediately.
actual: Row total updates, but Grand Total box shows old total until page reload.

title: Order total differs between Checkout preview screen and Order History details
steps: Note preview total on checkout screen (e.g. ₹1,450.00)
Complete order and open order details in /orders
expected: Saved order total matches checkout preview total.
actual: Order History total is ₹1,550.00 (adds hidden ₹100 handling fee on backend).

title: Seeded product 'Smart Fitness Watch' displays price ₹2,999 on catalog but charges ₹3,499 in cart
steps: View 'Smart Fitness Watch' on homepage (displayed price ₹2,999)
Click 'Add to Cart' and open cart
expected: Cart item price is ₹2,999.
actual: Cart item price is ₹3,499 (database price mismatch).

title: Admin can move CANCELLED order back to PROCESSING status without stock validation
expected: System rejects transition or validates inventory.
actual: Status changes back to PROCESSING without error.

title: Protected /orders page renders full UI table for 1.5s before auth check redirect
expected: Page immediately redirects to /login without rendering page content.
actual: Order History table renders for 1.5 seconds before redirecting.

title: Logout clears localStorage token but leaves user profile in sessionStorage
expected: User state cleared, header displays 'Sign In'.
actual: Header greeting continues to display 'Alex' from sessionStorage.

title: Standard customer user can navigate to /admin route without router guard block
steps: Type URL /admin in browser address bar
expected: Redirected to 403 Forbidden or Home page.
actual: Admin dashboard renders for customer user.

BUG-042: Product edit API accepts non-admin requests if header X-Demo-Override: true is included
steps: Send PATCH /api/products/1 with customer token and header `X-Demo-Override: true`
expected: API returns 403 Forbidden.
actual: Product updated successfully.

title: Password reset request endpoint returns success for non-existent email addresses
expected: Returns error 'Email address not found'.
actual: Returns success message 'Password reset link sent'.

title: Session token expiration is checked using client machine clock instead of server timestamp
steps: Change local operating system clock forward by 2 days
expected: Server validates token against server time.
actual: Frontend declares token expired prematurely based on client clock.

title: Switching user accounts without closing tab retains previous user's address in checkout state
steps: Log in as Customer 1 and add shipping address
Log out and log in as Customer 2
expected: Checkout form displays Customer 2's address.
actual: Form retains Customer 1's cached address.

title: GET /api/orders/:id does not verify order ownership (IDOR vulnerability)
expected: API returns 403 Forbidden 'Access Denied'.
actual: API returns Customer 2's order details and address.

title: User profile endpoint GET /api/profile?userId=X exposes any user's profile details
expected: Displays Customer 1's profile only.
actual: Displays Admin user's profile details and phone number.

title: DELETE /api/cart/:id deletes cart item without verifying user ownership
steps: Send DELETE /api/cart/1 as Customer 2 for Customer 1's cart item ID
expected: API returns 403 Forbidden.
actual: Cart item deleted successfully.

title: POST /api/coupons/apply returns HTTP 200 OK for invalid coupons instead of HTTP 400
expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request.
actual: HTTP 200 OK with `{ success: false }` body.

title: GET /api/products/99999 returns HTTP 500 Server Error instead of HTTP 404 Not Found
steps: Send GET /api/products/99999 for non-existent product ID
expected: HTTP 404 Not Found.
actual: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error.

title: POST /api/auth/register accepts payload missing confirmPassword field
steps: Send POST /api/auth/register without confirmPassword in JSON payload
expected: Validation error 'confirmPassword field is required'.
actual: Registration succeeds.

title: GET /api/products?debug=true dumps database connection string in response header
expected: Debug mode disabled or sanitized.
actual: Response header `X-Debug-Db-Conn` leaks database credentials.

title: Cart subtotal in GET /api/cart rounds down to nearest integer (floor) causing 1-rupee mismatch
steps: Add item with price ₹499.90 to cart
Compare API subtotal vs frontend sum
expected: Subtotal = ₹499.90.
actual: API returns subtotal = 499 (floored).

title: GET /api/products/:id returns discount: null for 0% discount products
steps: Fetch product details for product with 0% discount (e.g. ID 4)
expected: Returns `discount: 0`.
actual: Returns `discount: null`.

title: PATCH /api/cart/:id accepts quantity as string '5' causing string concatenation
expected: Parsed as integer 5 or error thrown.
actual: Saved as string '5', next increment yields '51'.

title: POST /api/auth/login returns passwordHash field in response JSON
steps: Log in via API and inspect JSON response payload
expected: User object contains id, name, email, role only.
actual: User object includes `passwordHash` in cleartext.

title: Deleted products remain active in user's shopping cart
expected: Cart flags item as 'Unavailable' or removes it.
actual: Deleted product remains in cart and can be checked out.

title: Checkout failure decrements product inventory stock before payment completes
steps: Proceed to checkout and enable 'Simulate Gateway Payment Error'
Submit order and inspect product stock in database
expected: Payment fails and product stock remains 15 units.
actual: Payment fails, but stock is decremented to 14 units.

title: Guest cart items saved in localStorage survive user logout
expected: Guest session cart is cleared.
actual: Guest cart items persist in localStorage after logout.

title: Admin order status update DB write delay causes immediate re-fetch to show old status
steps: Change order status in Admin panel
expected: Shows updated order status.
actual: Shows old status temporarily due to non-blocking DB transaction.

title: Adding same product twice creates duplicate cart rows instead of incrementing quantity
steps: Navigate back to product page and click 'Add to Cart' again
expected: Existing cart row quantity increments to 2.
actual: Two separate cart rows created for the same product.

title: Rapidly double-clicking 'Complete Order' button creates duplicate orders in database
steps: On checkout page, double-click 'Complete Order' button rapidly
expected: Submit button disabled immediately upon first click.
actual: Two identical orders created for single cart purchase.

title: Search input fires un-debounced API request on every keystroke
steps: Type 'headphones' quickly in search input on /search
expected: Single debounced API request fired after typing stops.
actual: 10 separate API requests fired (one per character typed).

title: Product listing page fetches all products in single call when category filter is selected
expected: API returns 8 items for page 1.
actual: API ignores limit and returns all catalog items.

title: GET /api/admin/orders endpoint executes N+1 database queries
steps: Navigate to /admin and select 'All Orders' tab
expected: Orders fetched via SQL JOIN in single query.
actual: Executes 1 query for orders + N queries for each order's user and items.

title: Hero banner image loads uncompressed 8MB high-res raw image
steps: Inspect image asset load size in Network tab
expected: Optimized web image (< 200KB).
actual: Loads raw 8MB 4000px image.

title: ProductCard component re-renders entire grid list on every hover state change
expected: Only target hovered card updates.
actual: All 8 product cards in grid re-render due to missing memoization.

title: Checkout form layout breaks into overlapping column on tablet screen width (768px - 991px)
steps: Resize browser window width between 768px and 991px
expected: Side-by-side or stacked clean layout.
actual: Form and summary cards collapse into overlapping block.

title: Product grid card text overflows card boundary on 375px mobile viewport
steps: Emulate Mobile Viewport (375px) in Chrome DevTools
expected: Product grid fits nicely within 375px viewport.
actual: Right edge of grid card overflows viewport boundary by 25px.

title: Long product title 'Ultra-High Definition Noise Cancelling Wireless Headphones Pro Max' wraps into 4 lines expanding card height
steps: View product card for item SKU ELEC-LNG-030
expected: Title truncated with ellipsis (...).
actual: Title stretches card container vertically, breaking grid alignment.

title: Cart table quantity buttons squish outside viewport on mobile screens (< 576px)
expected: Cart table horizontally scrolls or stacks items vertically.
actual: Quantity buttons squished off-screen.

title: Coupon submit button on mobile viewport is hidden under fixed footer bar
expected: Submit button visible and accessible.
actual: Button obscured under viewport footer.

title: Filtering catalog by category 'InvalidCat' displays generic unhandled error screen
expected: Displays friendly message 'No products found in category'.
actual: Renders blank error alert with raw exception text.

title: Simulated payment timeout leaves 'Processing Payment...' loading spinner active indefinitely
steps: On checkout, check 'Simulate Gateway Payment Error'
expected: Error message displayed and submit button re-enabled.
actual: Submit button remains disabled in 'Processing Payment...' spinner state indefinitely.

title: Invalid string product ID e.g. /products/abc triggers unhandled frontend error
expected: Redirects to 404 Not Found page.
actual: Throws uncaught JavaScript NaN exception.

title: Checkout failure clears cart items despite order placement error
steps: Check 'Simulate Gateway Payment Error' on checkout page
expected: Order fails and items remain in cart for retry.
actual: Order fails but backend deletes cart items anyway.

title: Registration password mismatch server error returns generic 'Internal Error 500'
expected: Validation message 'Passwords do not match'.
actual: Displays 'Internal Error 500'.
